unit: one independently named pooled experimental preparation; GEM groups are technical captures, not biological units
role: new experiment within exposed study; not independent study or animal replication
admission: single targets only; >=100 assigned treated cells and >=100 explicit controls; preserve every exclusion; no treated RNA inspection before prediction seal

objective.replacement: Explicit new single-gene research objective. Prior HSPA5/XBP1-v1 rejected before outcome access; prior immediate-early failure unchanged.
objective.coverageGate: HSPA5 fixed training feature and detected in >=20% of reserved controls

models: fixed diagnosed distribution AdamW width64, lr0.001 wd0.0001; same three checkpoints, validation only; descriptor/ID/shuffled/ridge; training data unchanged
evaluation: all eligible targets; no-intervention, training-mean and random selection; regret and gene residuals; one experimental unit means biological confidence unavailable
budget: one preparation, one model campaign, no objective substitution after outcomes
